note: Spur list rolled up from floor_spurs_*.json. Oct 12 files (tag box, box-load) are a different day and are not the 2026-10-25 baseline. channel12_strongest is the intermittent line within 10 MHz of 2467 MHz when that frequency is inside the 80 MS/s window. P_fa is not estimated.

acceptance.reason: False when any 2026-10-25 closed-box gain-60 capture at 2442 MHz has an intermittent line inside 2457–2477 MHz at least 10 dB above the floor. 6 of 6 boards do. The median floor did not rise; the leakage is bursts. P_fa is not in this file.
